sections.heading: COMMERCIAL READ — interpretation, not a rate
sections.body:
• Insured-region adjacency. These rows are CONUS-wide, not Gulf-coast: the archive scores no sub-CONUS region, and crossings include Florida as well as Texas and Louisiana. 10 of 12 crossed at any intensity (83.3%, 55-95%); 1 of 12 at ≥64 kt (8.3%, 1-35%). A hurricane-force attachment rests on one archived event. Bound or challenge a rate set elsewhere; do not derive one.
  • Energy adjacency and timing. Transit to a CONUS crossing is a median 65.5 h, its upper quartile largely one 1971 track re-counted.
  • BASIS RISK. ANITA 1977 formed 126 km from this cell and struck Tamaulipas; ALICIA 1983 formed 194 km from it and struck Texas — one cell, two coasts. Peak is not landfall intensity: FERN 1971 peaked at 80 kt, its Louisiana crossings 25 kt.

sections.heading: Near-misses: where the basis risk is
sections.body: NEAR MISSES. Anita 1977 formed 126 km from the cell and struck Tamaulipas at 120 kt — inside the cohort, outside the CONUS row. Alicia 1983 formed 194 km out and struck Texas at 100 kt: the single member behind CONUS — ≥64 kt, and at 150 km not a member. Barry 2019 formed 110 km out with a 65 kt Louisiana landfall, but its 11 July genesis is outside the window.

sections.heading: Basis risk — read before writing the trigger
sections.body:
• Same genesis cell ≠ same landfall. Twelve storms formed inside one 250 km circle and went to Texas, Louisiana, Florida and Tamaulipas.
  • Same class ≠ same local outcome. The archive scores a crossing and its intensity, not a footprint or a loss.
  • A CONUS row is not a state row. No state-level landfall is scored, at any radius or sample size.
  • The interval is the precision. 1 of 12 is 8.3%, 95% Wilson 1-35%.

sections.body: A research-only historical genesis/outcome engine for the North Atlantic and East Pacific: give it a genesis point or a declared pre-genesis reference cell and it returns what the record did next as exact n/N with a 95% Wilson interval, names every storm in the denominator, and refuses what the record cannot carry.

• Condition on a point. A genesis position or a declared pre-genesis reference cell, with a stated radius and month window. Rates assume formation — not P(forms), not a live feed, not a cone.
  • Retrieve the analog tracks. Every storm in the cohort, and representative members under a stated rule with genesis date, distance from the cell, peak and their own landfalls. Nothing is ranked a closest analog.
  • Compare contract rows. Reached TD, TS and Cat 1–5, each exact n/N with a 95% Wilson interval; six landfall regions, each an “any” and a ≥64 kt pair. State-level landfall is not scored.
  • Read the refusals as output. Below min sample: counts, no rate, no interval. Move the cell and watch N and the refusal move with it.

An interpolated fix never establishes a threshold crossing, so time-to-hurricane is never dated off a wind nobody measured. A cohort’s defining variable is not reported back as an outcome of it, with one exception left in the open: every cohort returns reached TD at 100%, because a cohort is storms that formed. Below min sample a rate is refused rather than estimated. An absent outcome is not a zero. Every figure carries a pack stamp and a URL that reproduces it.

A browser and replayable cohort URLs. A URL carries the cell, radius, season floor, month window, basin and methodology version, so a reviewer opens the same cohort and reads the same counts, rates, intervals and refusals.

sections.body: What the archive supports from a declared Gulf cell — and where it stops short of a published Cat 4+ CONUS landfall trigger.

Reference event — a Category 4+ hurricane makes US landfall before 30 Nov 2026. Cat 4 130 mph sustained. Trigger — the hurricane centre crosses the contiguous-US coastline at Cat 4 or higher. Determination — landfall and intensity by the NHC, at landfall. Region — the lower 48, plus stated Gulf-only and Florida-only variants. PUBLIC FACTS ONLY — no access to any Discrete transaction, pricing process, client or methodology is implied, and Storm Atlas neither prices nor scores this contract.
Conditional on formation in the declared cell — none is a probability for {{LIVE}} or for Discrete's contract.

NAMED HISTORY — ATLAS MODELLED RECORDS, NOT NHC SETTLEMENT DETERMINATIONS. By the archive's rule (majors first, then peak descending; never similarity): ANITA 1977, the one Cat 4, has its Cat 4 crossing recorded in Tamaulipas, Mexico; ALICIA 1983, the one CONUS ≥64 kt crossing, at Cat 3 in Texas. Neither is evidence for Discrete's trigger.

• An auditable historical denominator — twelve named storms behind one declared condition, with an interval on each row.
  • A replayable cohort for counterparty review, and research input upstream of contract design — not where it is priced.

This page does not price the contract, estimate fair value, predict landfall, estimate the chance {{LIVE}} triggers anything, replace the NHC, or supply settlement data. WHAT ATLAS ADDS: a declared cohort, exact n / N with a 95% Wilson interval, a visible refusal, a replay URL.
